base_height.name: base_height
base_height.semantics: root world z minus environment origin z
base_height.candidate_usage_guidance: use as a stance and fall-risk feature with roll and pitch
base_height.known_limitations: metres; use base_height_relative to compare robot sizes

roll.name: roll
roll.semantics: base roll angle derived from root orientation
roll.fallback_behavior: zero fallback when orientation is unavailable
roll.candidate_usage_guidance: penalize large absolute roll as a stability risk
roll.known_limitations: zero fallback can hide missing orientation data

pitch.name: pitch
pitch.semantics: base pitch angle derived from root orientation
pitch.fallback_behavior: zero fallback when orientation is unavailable
pitch.candidate_usage_guidance: penalize large absolute pitch as a forward/backward fall risk
pitch.known_limitations: zero fallback can hide missing orientation data

base_pos_xy.name: base_pos_xy
base_pos_xy.semantics: base xy position relative to the environment origin
base_pos_xy.fallback_behavior: zero vector fallback when base position is unavailable
base_pos_xy.candidate_usage_guidance: use for bounded drift diagnostics, not absolute map location
base_pos_xy.known_limitations: origin-relative position is not a global navigation target

base_lin_vel.name: base_lin_vel
base_lin_vel.semantics: raw SI velocity in the robot base frame; the corresponding scaled field uses world coordinates
base_lin_vel.fallback_behavior: zero vector fallback when velocity is unavailable
base_lin_vel.candidate_usage_guidance: use for recovery damping and excessive drift penalties
base_lin_vel.known_limitations: do not mix base-frame raw vectors with world-frame scaled vectors

base_ang_vel.name: base_ang_vel
base_ang_vel.semantics: raw SI velocity in the robot base frame; the corresponding scaled field uses world coordinates
base_ang_vel.fallback_behavior: zero vector fallback when angular velocity is unavailable
base_ang_vel.candidate_usage_guidance: use for rotational damping and instability diagnostics
base_ang_vel.known_limitations: do not mix base-frame raw vectors with world-frame scaled vectors

projected_gravity.name: projected_gravity
projected_gravity.semantics: gravity direction projected into the base frame
projected_gravity.fallback_behavior: zero vector fallback when orientation is unavailable
projected_gravity.known_limitations: zero fallback should not be interpreted as a valid gravity direction

commanded_base_vel.name: commanded_base_vel
commanded_base_vel.semantics: public commanded base velocity vector when a command manager is available
commanded_base_vel.fallback_behavior: zero vector fallback when command is unavailable
commanded_base_vel.candidate_usage_guidance: compare actual velocity to command only when command signal is meaningful
commanded_base_vel.known_limitations: zero command can mean either stand-still command or missing command source

joint_pos.name: joint_pos
joint_pos.semantics: joint position vector in runner joint order
joint_pos.fallback_behavior: zero matrix fallback when joint positions are unavailable
joint_pos.candidate_usage_guidance: use for posture regularization and range diagnostics
joint_pos.known_limitations: joint order is runner-owned and should not be inferred from names

joint_vel.name: joint_vel
joint_vel.semantics: joint velocity vector in runner joint order
joint_vel.fallback_behavior: zero matrix fallback when joint velocities are unavailable
joint_vel.candidate_usage_guidance: use for smoothness and instability penalties
joint_vel.known_limitations: large penalties can suppress recovery actions

joint_pos_error.name: joint_pos_error
joint_pos_error.semantics: joint_pos minus runner default joint position
joint_pos_error.fallback_behavior: zero matrix fallback when default joint position is unavailable
joint_pos_error.candidate_usage_guidance: use for soft posture bias, not hard constraints
joint_pos_error.known_limitations: default posture is runner-owned and task fixed

last_action.name: last_action
last_action.semantics: current policy action vector for the step
last_action.fallback_behavior: zero fallback when action is unavailable
last_action.candidate_usage_guidance: use for action magnitude diagnostics or gentle regularization
last_action.known_limitations: action units are policy-space values, not joint torques

prev_action.name: prev_action
prev_action.semantics: previous policy action vector from runner-owned action history
prev_action.fallback_behavior: zero previous action on first step or reset
prev_action.candidate_usage_guidance: use with action_delta for smoothness diagnostics
prev_action.known_limitations: reset handling can produce legitimate zeros

action_delta.name: action_delta
action_delta.fallback_behavior: current action minus zero on first step or reset
action_delta.candidate_usage_guidance: use to discourage abrupt control changes without blocking recovery
action_delta.known_limitations: over-penalizing action changes can hurt push recovery

push_active.name: push_active
push_active.semantics: one only on the current step of an actual task-controller injected push; zero otherwise
push_active.known_limitations: not latched through recovery and never inferred from autonomous robot motion

push_vec_public.name: push_vec_public
push_vec_public.semantics: actual injected planar velocity increment for this step; zero when push_active is zero
push_vec_public.known_limitations: already occurred event only; no future timing, direction, severity or schedule

progress_fraction.name: progress_fraction
progress_fraction.semantics: runner-owned training progress fraction for the current step
progress_fraction.fallback_behavior: runner supplies a clamped value in [0, 1]
progress_fraction.candidate_usage_guidance: use only for mild annealing inside candidate reward logic
progress_fraction.known_limitations: not an eval metric and not a budget control

nominal_base_height.name: nominal_base_height
nominal_base_height.semantics: bound robot nominal base height L; a spatial normalization, not a success threshold

base_height_relative.name: base_height_relative
base_height_relative.semantics: origin-relative base height divided by nominal_base_height

base_lin_vel_scaled.name: base_lin_vel_scaled
base_lin_vel_scaled.semantics: world-frame linear velocity divided by sqrt(g*L)

base_ang_vel_scaled.name: base_ang_vel_scaled
base_ang_vel_scaled.semantics: world-frame angular velocity multiplied by sqrt(L/g)

terminated_non_timeout.name: terminated_non_timeout
terminated_non_timeout.semantics: task termination mask before reset; timeout alone is excluded

reserved_field_policy.reason: reserved fields are unavailable for candidate logic; an empty set means all listed fields are prompt-effective
